slug: 2024-06-11 Review of Somalia's Data Protection Act and implementing regulations

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory states the Data Protection Act was enacted on 23 March 2023 and became effective immediately throughout Somalia, as the country's first comprehensive data protection law.

The review describes mandatory registration of controllers of major importance within six months and annual audit reports under the Authority's guidance, with no decision or count reported (date is the article's published date).
The Act established the Somalia Data Protection Authority, which the review says was officially launched in February 2024 and commenced activities before then.
